verdict.rationale: Algolia is a hosted API platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question here. The evidence shows only human-readable REST API reference pages and an llms.txt documentation index, which is not a machine-readable API spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and no other evidence shows a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
